comment: ANCHOR: BUILD_HERMES_CANONICAL_STATUS_LINEAGE_20261107 — LQ-20261107-478. The canonical snapshot the
portal, the matrix Markdown and the Word doc are regenerated from carried a db_tables list of six tables
hermes_research_intelligence 1,976 rows against 21,202 live, hermes_memory_events 438 against 17,492,
hermes_validation_findings 28 against 29,831. The list and its counts are now measured read-only from
the DB through the shared credential loader (never a psql shell-out), and the snapshot is the labelled
fallback that says the live read failed. Listing it schedules nothing.
